## Error handler
Runs whenever a workflow with `errorWorkflow` set to this one fails, including a trigger or activation error, which carries no `execution` key. Reads config itself (not through a sub-workflow), then emails the operator a plain-text alert naming the failed node, the error, the execution URL, and the time in Bogota. This workflow carries no `errorWorkflow` of its own, so a failure here does not loop back into itself.

## Email operator
Every field anchors on `$('On workflow error').first().json`, with optional chaining and fallbacks, because `$json` here is `{ config }` after "Parse config", not the trigger's own output — and a trigger or activation error carries no `execution` key at all, only `trigger`.

parameters.subject: =[Chivabox demo] Workflow failed: {{ (({ workflow }) => workflow?.name ?? 'unknown workflow')($('On workflow error').first().json) }}
